issues.description: Constructor 'Lecture(...)' parameter list mismatch: The template repository declares a constructor signature public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) (3 parameters). The problem statement (task instructions and UML) and the solution repository expect a constructor that initializes all five attributes in this exact order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) (5 parameters). This discrepancy directly contradicts the specified attribute initialization order and can confuse students about the required constructor signature and lead to compilation or test failures if the autograder or tests expect the five-parameter constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template constructor signature match the problem statement/UML and the solution by replacing the three-parameter constructor with a five-parameter constructor stub that follows the exact parameter order from the UML: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { /* TODO: initialize fields */ }. Alternatively, remove the incorrect three-parameter constructor so students implement the correct five-parameter constructor themselves. Ensure the parameter order matches the UML to avoid student confusion.
